vulnerabilities.description: Token expiration check bypass in /api/v1/auth endpoint. Malformed JWTs with empty exp claim are accepted.
vulnerabilities.remediation: Validate JWT structure and expiration claims on the server side, not just the signature.

vulnerabilities.description: Rate limiting can be bypassed by distributing requests across multiple IP addresses. Current implementation tracks per-IP only.
vulnerabilities.remediation: Implement per-user rate limiting using authenticated tokens as identifiers.

vulnerabilities.description: Webhook endpoint reveals service version in error messages (v2.1.0).
vulnerabilities.remediation: Remove version information from error messages and responses.
